name: Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalaya
target_group: Girls from disadvantaged groups in educationally backward areas, as defined by the scheme
eligibility: Eligibility is based on the current Samagra Shiksha/KGBV guidelines and local selection rules.
benefits: Residential schooling/support for eligible girls at upper-primary/secondary level, including education and related facilities.
application_process: Apply through the concerned school/education department/district mechanism.
source: Department of School Education and Literacy / Government of India
